title: Cloudflare Status - Cloudflare Workers AI Issues
text:
Service: Cloudflare Status
Incident: Cloudflare Workers AI Issues
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-10-15T07:10:58.804Z
Resolved: 2026-10-15T09:37:03.607Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-15T09:37:03.607Z: resolved - This incident has been resolved.
- 2026-10-15T07:57:49.667Z: monitoring - We are continuing to monitor for any further issues.
- 2026-10-15T07:10:58.804Z: investigating - Cloudflare has identified an issue whereby customers might experience errors from inference requests to certain models using Workers AI.

These are the list of impacted model:
@cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-flash-0731
@cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro-0813
@cf/zai-org/glm-5.2
@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3
@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3-flash

We are working to mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.

incident_updates.body: We are continuing to monitor for any further issues.

affected_components.name: Cloudflare Sites and Services - Workers AI

components.name: Workers AI
components.description: Workers AI allows you to run machine learning models, on the Cloudflare network, from your own code – whether that be from Workers, Pages, or anywhere via REST API.
